newReleases.name: Storm Born Kicker Bolt N Ball
newReleases.desc:
A mysterious accident changes everything. While driving through the city, our hero gets caught in a sudden crash. But instead of ending his journey, the accident awakens an incredible power within him the power of electricity!

Now, a simple ball is no longer just a ball. With every powerful kick, it can travel at lightning speed. Guided by a skilled trainer, master your new ability and prove that lightning can turn an ordinary kick into an unstoppable shot.

Swipe your finger across the screen to draw the perfect path for the ball. Aim carefully, control your direction, and let the player kick the ball with electrifying force. Score goals, overcome challenging obstacles, and use your lightning-powered kicks to complete each level on the road classes.

The journey takes place across dynamic city roads, where every level brings a new challenge. As you progress, the difficulty increases, demanding better aim, faster reactions, and smarter use of your special power.

newReleases.name: Otterlines: Fun Through Books
newReleases.desc:
With Otterlines, building a healthy reading habit becomes a joyful shared experience. 

We provide quality screen time by combining engaging storybooks and interactive activities designed to boost creativity, deep comprehension, and cognitive skills in young readers.

Gather the family on the couch, get cozy, and step into a magical world waiting for you between the lines!

Team: Giovana Diesel, Giulia Chimini Stefainski, Maria Eduarda Santellano Maidana Carvalho, Richard Fagundes Rodrigues, and Vítor Bruno de Oliveira

newReleases.name: Tiny Gambit: Chess Puzzles
newReleases.desc:
Small moves. Big puzzles.

Guide Arin or Mira through colorful islands in a chess-inspired puzzle adventure. Walk one or two steps, then watch each opposing color reply. Read the board, capture the pieces in your way, and reach the treasure safely.

LEARN BY PLAYING
An interactive introduction teaches movement, captures, and enemy replies. Discover all six chess pieces and inspect their reach whenever you need a closer look. These are original puzzle rules inspired by chess, not a traditional chess match.

KEEP YOUR MIND MOVING
Play 20 introductory puzzles, then continue through endless generated challenges. Every board has a solution without tools. Earn up to three stars, retry for free, and return to improve your best result.

A LITTLE ADVENTURE EVERY DAY
Try the daily puzzle, collect daily gifts, and spend earned coins on optional hints and tools. Share your achievements and compare progress through optional Game Center leaderboards.

PLAY YOUR WAY
Choose your hero, adjust music and haptics, and use board labels, larger text, VoiceOver, or Reduce Motion. Core puzzles work offline; ads, purchases, and Game Center require a connection. Progress is saved on your device.

Tiny Gambit contains automatic ads and optional rewarded videos. A one-time Remove Ads purchase permanently removes automatic full-screen ads. Rewarded videos remain optional. No subscription.

Play offline. Progress is saved locally and syncs to your private iCloud database when iCloud is available.

newReleases.name: Case 16: Murder Sudoku
newReleases.desc:
A murder, a floor plan, and a clue from every suspect.

Put each suspect on the square where they stood: one to a row, one to a column. The victim was alone with the killer, so whoever shares their room did it. No guessing, no luck — every case has exactly one answer, and you can reach it by reasoning alone.

THE RULES FIT ON A CARD
• One suspect to every row and every column.
• "Beside" means left, right, above or below — never diagonal, never through a wall.
• Nobody stands on furniture. Tables, plants and boxes are solid; chairs, beds and carpets are somewhere to be.
• The victim was alone with the killer. Their room holds exactly two people.

80 CASES, EASIEST FIRST
From a 5×5 warm-up to 12×12 boards that take a whole evening. Bars, ferries, hospitals, film sets, a reading of the will. Every difficulty is measured from the steps it takes to solve, not guessed, so the case number is the ladder.

A NEW CAST EVERY CASE
Suspects are dealt fresh for each case — different faces, clothes, hats and habits — so you are never solving the same five people twice.

THE MONTHLY CASE
Once a month, one big 12×12 case and one attempt. Fastest times go on the ranking.

HINTS THAT TEACH
Stuck? A hint shows the next step of the deduction and why it follows — never just the answer.

FAIR ABOUT ADS
Every case is free, and ads pay for them. A hint plays a short ad first; leaving a case you have just solved plays one. An ad never plays before the reveal, and time spent on an ad never counts on y

newReleases.name: Ant Laboratory
newReleases.desc:
Ant Laboratory is a living ant colony to watch, and a laboratory to study it in. Release one queen into a glass ant farm, watch her colony grow, then follow it out across an island of its own.

Begin with one queen
Choose from six species: black garden, fire, wood, leafcutter, carpenter and harvester ants, each with its own nest, diet and habits. Pick one of six soils for the farm; only the look changes. Release the queen and watch the first workers emerge (the wood ant's solo start is Experimental). Every ant in the farm is simulated: nurses feed larvae, diggers carve tunnels and rooms, foragers follow scent trails and undertakers clear away the dead. Follow one worker close up with the Ant cam.

A living ant farm
Tap Habitat to set the light, the water and the warmth. Choose Bright, Soft or Off, any colour, or up to twice as bright. The mister can water the soil by itself, and a heat mat can hold the warmth. Mould grows where it is damp, tiny springtails graze it, and the ants catch them. Over weeks the bare surface turns green with algae, moss and grass (how fast is Experimental). Keep the soil too dry or too wet for days, or the heat mat too hot, and some brood dies. Adult ants are never harmed by the habitat.

An automatic feeder keeps the colony fed. Tap Feed to offer seeds, sugar, a fly or a cricket, and follow the food home.

Keep it, or let it out
When the colony fills the farm, you choose. Keep it contained, and it grows on slowly for years while it has food to spar

newReleases.name: 321: Football & Basketball
newReleases.desc:
Two teams appear on the board. Name a player who suited up for both.

That's the whole game. It sounds easy until the clock starts.

RACE A REAL RIVAL
Quick Match drops you into a live duel in seconds. You and your opponent see the same two teams at the same time, and you're both typing. First to three rounds takes the match. Thirty seconds a round, and every answer your rival lands is one you can't use.

Prefer to pick your opponent? Create a private room and send the four-letter code to a friend.

TWO SPORTS, EVERY ROSTER
14,584 players. Every pro football team since 1970 and every pro basketball team since 1947, including every relocation — when a franchise moves cities, both names count.

Pick your sport when you start and switch anytime from the badge.

FOUR NEW GAMES EVERY DAY
A fresh set every morning, one try each:
• Shared Player — find everyone who played for both teams
• Team Hunt — name every team one player suited up for
• Career Route — put a career in chronological order
• Player Chain — link teams through the players they share

FIVE SHIRTS
Five teams on the board, three turns each. On your turn, name a player and score by how many of the five teams he played for. Fifteen seconds a turn — let the clock run out and the turn is gone.

CLIMB
Weekly and monthly leaderboards, a career rank that carries your record, achievements, and three daily missions worth reputation points. Add friends and see where you land against them.

FAIR PLAY
Ten free matches every day.

newReleases.name: Woodpile: Sort Puzzle
newReleases.desc:
Woodpile is a sorting puzzle that waits for you.

A woodpile seen end-on: round log ends packed into a small hex lattice, each one wearing a painted colour mark the way a forester marks timber. Three stacks sit under the pile. Drag one onto any free cell and the pile sorts itself - neighbouring stacks with the same colour on top slide together, and when ten of a kind sit together they are carted off. That is the entire rule set.

A PUZZLE THAT DOES NOT HURRY YOU

No timer. No move limit. No energy meter, no lives, no daily login reward. Put the phone down mid-thought and the pile is exactly where you left it. Nothing in Woodpile is built to pull you back - it is built to be worth coming back to.

THE PILE DOES THE SORTING

You only decide where a stack goes. Everything after that is the pile's own logic, played out in front of you: a merge exposes a new colour, which matches another neighbour, which fills a run to ten, which clears and exposes the next. The satisfying part of a good move is watching how far it travels.

TODAY'S PILE

One pile a day, dealt from the date itself, identical for everyone who plays it. There is no server and no account - the stacks are worked out from today's number on your own device, so it works on a plane.

Next to your score sits par: what a careful reference player scores on that same pile. Beating par is a real result, not a leaderboard position shared with a stranger who played for six hours. Share the day's result as a small picture of how

newReleases.name: Bottle Baron
newReleases.desc:
The city is drowning in bottles, cans and trash – and Garbage Gary is making a fortune dumping it all in the wrong place. You start with a shopping cart in a Copenhagen backyard. You finish as the Bottle Baron.

BUILD THE RECYCLING CHAIN
Collect, return deposits, sort and process. Four stations work together in one chain, and every upgrade makes the money roll in faster. Hire Bent, Birthe, Freja and Kofi to run the stations, and they keep earning while you're away.

SORT IT RIGHT – AND LEARN WHY
Pizza boxes, light bulbs, milk cartons, batteries: the items ride past on the belt, and you have to get each one into the right bin in time. The game uses the ten Danish waste types, and when you get one wrong, it tells you why. The sorting guide keeps everything you've learned, so you sort it right at home too.

BEAT GARBAGE GARY
Gary cheats, taunts and grabs the best contracts if you're not faster. Race him for the contracts, and clean up the city one district at a time.

FROM THE BACKYARD TO NEW YORK
Five chapters take you from the backyard and Copenhagen to Berlin, Tokyo and New York. Every city brings new bins, new rules and a new goal.

EVERY DAY
• A daily challenge with the same belt for everyone
• A login calendar and achievements
• Reminders when your stations are full (only if you want them)

FAIR AND NO PRESSURE
• The game is free, and everything can be reached without paying
• No ads that interrupt you: only videos you choose to watch for a reward
• No account and no track

newReleases.name: Master Bubble Pop - Shooter
newReleases.desc:
Aim, match and pop your way through Master Bubble Pop, a colorful bubble shooter puzzle game with trapped gems to rescue, swinging boss boards and 120 levels to master on iPhone and iPad.

Line up your shot, bank it off the walls and match 3 or more bubbles of the same color to pop them. Bubbles left hanging drop too, so one clever shot can bring down a whole cluster. Easy to pick up, satisfying to master, and you can play it anytime, even offline.

HOW TO PLAY
- Drag to aim and release to shoot
- Match 3 or more bubbles of the same color to pop them
- Tap the launcher to swap to your next bubble
- Rescue every gem, or clear the board, before your moves run out

RESCUE THE TRAPPED GEMS

From level 3, sparkling gems are locked inside bubbles. Pop the bubble holding a gem to set it loose, and rescue every gem before you run out of moves to clear the level.

EPIC BOSS LEVEL
Every 10th level is a boss level. The whole bubble board swings from side to side, you get fewer moves, and there are more gems to rescue. Time every shot to win.

FEWER MOVES, MORE STARS
Finish with moves to spare to earn up to 3 stars. Every move you don't use turns into bonus points and extra coins, so the smartest shots earn the biggest rewards.

POWERFUL BOOSTERS
- Rainbow: matches every color it touches
- Bomb: blasts all the bubbles around it
- Double Score: doubles the points from your shot
- Side Sweep: clears the whole row it lands in
- Deep Drill: clears the whole column it lands in

GAME FEATURES

newReleases.name: Shaker Town: Drink Sort Café
newReleases.desc:
Welcome to Shaker Town, the cozy café where every puzzle you solve pours a drink for a real guest.

Tilt the bottle, watch the liquid flow and settle, and sort every color until each glass runs pure. It's the relaxing color-sort puzzle you love, with pours so smooth you can almost hear them. And every level you win serves a guest, earns tips and brings your little café back to life.

WHY YOU'LL LOVE SHAKER TOWN

SATISFYING LIQUID SORT
Lift, tilt and pour: the liquid splashes, ripples and fills with a soft, rising sound. Easy to learn, calming to play and hard to put down.

A CAFÉ THAT COMES ALIVE
Your café is your home screen. Watch guests stroll in, queue at the counter, take a seat and enjoy the drink you just made. Tap their bubbles to collect tips and hearts.

RENOVATE THE NEIGHBORHOOD
Spend your coins to restore the café, its terrace and the little shops next door, one piece at a time. The prettier the street, the more guests come by and the higher your café's reputation climbs.

CAFÉ RUSH
A guest in a hurry? Serve their drink before the clock runs out for a bonus reward. Everywhere else, you play at your own pace.

BONUSES, MISSIONS AND CHESTS
A tour bus, a happy hour, a visiting food critic: fun bonuses pop up on the map throughout the day. Complete your Daily Missions to open reward chests.

HUNDREDS OF LEVELS
From your first pour to tricky Hard levels with a moves budget, little shakers and colored padlocks, the puzzles grow with you. Use Undo, Hint or an extra glass

newReleases.name: Ion Siege: Rogue Survivor
newReleases.desc:
Defend the core. Survive the swarm. Build the perfect neon tower.

ION SIEGE is a roguelite idle tower defense. Waves of geometric enemies close in from every side while your tower fires on its own. Spend Cash during the run, pick a Perk every time you level up, and grow stronger for the next run with permanent upgrades.

WHAT YOU DO
- Defend 10 Sectors, each with 20 waves, Elites and a Boss at the end.
- Pick 1 of 3 Perks as you level up: every run plays differently.
- Upgrade your tower in the Workshop while the battle is on, and trigger EMP to blast and freeze what gets close.
- Fire the EMP at the right moment to survive the Boss waves.

BUILD YOUR TOWER
- 9 towers, each with its own ability: rotating Defense Orbs, a focused beam, freezing bursts, splitting shots, burning plasma, a fortress shield, heavy artillery, chain lightning and gravity wells.
- 18 Modules in 3 categories (Attack, Defense, Tactical): missiles, railguns, drones, shields, repair swarms and more. Level them up with Coins; merge copies to raise their rarity and add more missiles, beams or drones.
- Talents, a research Lab, Quests, a Season Pass and an Endless mode with a leaderboard.

PLAY YOUR WAY
- Free to play. Ads are optional and only appear if you choose to watch one for a reward.
- Idle rewards keep your progress growing while you are away.
- Works offline. Link Game Center, Apple or Google to restore your progress on a new device.

VIP PASS (optional auto-renewing subscription)
- VIP Pass Weekly

newReleases.name: JCE Chess Studio
newReleases.desc:
JCE Chess Studio is a powerful, feature-rich chess app for iPhone and iPad that combines beautiful design with serious functionality. Whether you're learning the game or preparing for tournament play, JCE Chess Studio gives you the tools to study, practice and improve.

WHAT MAKES JCE CHESS STUDIO SPECIAL

• Play Anywhere, Anytime – The built-in JCE engine (Jeff Chess Engine) runs entirely on your device, so you can play offline with no internet connection.
• Challenging AI – JCE, an original engine written for this app, offers 21 skill levels, from beginner up to full strength.
• Watch JCE Play Itself – Set JCE to play both sides, pick a level, then sit back and watch. Analyze the saved game later.
• Professional Analysis – Real-time position evaluation and move hints help you understand the game.
• Study Tools – Set up any position to practice specific scenarios, openings or endgames. The built-in FEN parser accepts only fully legal positions.
• Time Controls – Practice with realistic tournament time settings, including increments.
• Save Games – Save complete or partial games to continue or review later, send to friends, or open in other chess apps.
• Share Games – Share any game at any point using the standard iOS share sheet, as a FEN string or as PGN text or a PGN file.
• Import Games – Reopen your saved games to continue play or review them exactly as they were. Bring in FEN or PGN files from anywhere by dropping them into the JCE Chess folder in the Files app.
• Class

newReleases.name: Within Reach: Physics Puzzle
newReleases.desc:
Take a photo of a real mug and drop it into a cardboard puzzle. It falls like a mug and weighs what a mug weighs.
Season 1 is free: 34 boxes and the whole first story. No ads, no subscription.

Every level is a handmade cardboard box with a test rig inside: a lift that won’t budge for less than a kilo, or a glass pane right next to an egg. The game never hands you the answer. You look around the room, pick something and photograph it. The game cuts it out and works out what it’s made of and how heavy it is.

Then physics takes over. Glass shatters and rubber bounces. A sock lands with a flump, which is exactly what the egg was hoping for.

THE LAB
You’re the new night-shift tester at Pell & Pell, a two-storey lab that tests parcels before they’re posted. It’s run by sixty-year-old twins. Dot works downstairs and writes sticky notes. Ferdie works upstairs, types his memos in capitals and builds rigs he believes are impossible. On your first night his brass test weights vanish, so every box has to pass with your things. Their great-niece Nell, who is ten, takes the case.

IN THE BOX
• 110 physics puzzles in 7 places: Kitchen, Garage, Bathroom, Garden, Kids’ Room, Office and Attic
• Bertram, a tin wind-up car from 1958, has to reach the red flag in every box
• Painted story scenes between boxes, and a growing pile of notes on the desk
• Your Pocket keeps everything you’ve photographed, so you can play on the sofa or on a train
• Nothing within reach? Dot lends you her mug
• Phot

newReleases.name: Fivefold: Card Strategy
newReleases.desc:
Place three cards. Keep the rest for later.

Fivefold is an offline card strategy game for one player. You and a computer opponent share a standard 52-card deck. Over five rounds, place cards across five fronts worth different numbers of points.

Both sides reveal their placements together. Once played, a card stays on its front until the match ends. Build pairs, straights and three of a kind, and decide where to use your strongest cards. After round five, the stronger hand on each front wins its points. The highest total wins.

• Two difficulty levels: Casual and Tactician
• A step-by-step lesson and complete rules
• Saved matches you can resume and a local match history
• Sound, haptics and reduced-motion settings
• No account, internet connection, ads or in-app purchases

There is no betting, purchased currency or redeemable reward. Points count only toward the current match.

newReleases.name: Glimmo Party
newReleases.desc:
Roll the die, collect Stars, win minigames! Glimmo Party is a party board game for up to four, with 20 minigames and online play with friends. Everyone plays on their own iPhone.

THE NIGHT
Roll and move around the Harbor Market by night. Spaces give you sparks or take some away. At forks you pick your path. Pass the Star with enough sparks and you can take it; then it moves on. Whoever has the most Stars at the end wins.

At the Shop you get items for your backpack that help you along the way.

MINIGAMES
A minigame after every act. Swat the moths and leave the fireflies alone. Cast a line and tap when the float dips. Slice the moon, stack jars into a lighthouse, jump rope, sink light balls in billiards and hop from lantern to lantern. Sometimes free-for-all, sometimes 2 vs 2, sometimes 1 vs 3.

DUELS
Land on a Duel space and challenge someone. Who taps first when it flashes? Too early and you lose.

FINAL STRETCH
In the last five turns the Harbor Crab calls the final stretch. Whoever is last gets a gift, and a Duel from behind can now be for a Star.

THE GANG
Tropf, Murmel, Flamme and Splitter. The Harbor Crab hosts the night and tells you what just happened.

ONLINE
Invite your Game Center friends to the table. From your second night on you can also tap “Find a game” and play with others; the search takes up to a minute. Empty seats go to stand-ins, so two or three of you can start right away. Chat with stickers and fixed phrases, shown on each phone in English or German. M

newReleases.name: Dragonbound: Wings of Magic
newReleases.desc:
Step into the Dragon Knight Academy, master powerful magic, and hatch a dragon all your own. Feed it, train it, and watch it evolve into the partner who fights by your side.

But this isn't your first time here. On your last journey, the Chaos surge twisted your most trusted dragon into something monstrous. Now you've awoken, back on the very day you first met. 

Relearn your magic. Raise your dragon anew. Ride into battle on dragonback, uncover the truth behind the corruption, and push back the Chaos with your allies — to change the future.

【Choose Your Class, Forge Your Style】
Battle shifts in an instant, and so can you. Swap class roles on the fly, mix weapons and skills, and adapt from brutal melee to ranged magic whenever the fight demands it.

【Take to the Skies】
Mount your dragon and carry the battle into the air. Hunt down flying targets, dodge incoming fire, and unleash coordinated aerial strikes with your dragon at your side.

【Hunt the Demon Dragon】
A colossal Demon Dragon, twisted by Chaos, is awakening. Rally your party, read its patterns, strike its weak points, and focus your fire to bring down the beast in the heat of its fury.

【Build Your Home, Find Your Crew】
Meet allies from across the realm and explore the Heimdall Continent together. Build a magical home of your own — a warm base camp to return to before every new journey.

Connect with Your Goddesses

updates.name: Block Blast！

Enter the world of Block Blast, where every move is a test of your brain and strategy. Dive into the thrill of block crush gameplay—watch vibrant cubes explode in color as you solve each puzzle. With fresh daily puzzle challenges that keep your mind engaged and an endless high score system that rewards your best strategies, Block Blast delivers nonstop excitement for casual players and puzzle masters alike.

updates.name: Mob Control
updates.desc:
Lead, Multiply, and Conquer! Mob Control delivers thrilling tower defense action where you grow your mob, deploy powerful Champions, and crush enemy bases. Unlock collectible cards, conquer exciting modes, and climb the Champions League. Rise to tower defense supremacy!

Unleash Your Inner Commander in Mob Control: The Ultimate Tower Defense Clash!

Defend, Conquer, and Rise to Victory in this Epic Tower Defense Showdown!

Ready to become the ultimate tower defense champion? Test your skills, wit, and tactical prowess!

► Hundreds of Engaging Levels: New knitted layouts, color combinations, and puzzle arrangements appear throughout progression.
► Cozy Yarn Aesthetic: Soft textures, warm colors, and pleasant animations create a calm and enjoyable experience.

Yarn Loop offers a smooth, calm, and visually charming journey through handcrafted yarn puzzles.
